disagreements.title: Berth size limits do not say which boat length they mean
disagreements.a_reason: Related to D03 but a different element and page: D03 is the boat-details Length label, this is the 'Boats up to N metres' text on the berth cards, which stays ambiguous if only the field is fixed. A skipper with a bowsprit can pick a berth that fits the hull but not the length overall.
disagreements.b_reason: Same ambiguity as D03 (length overall or hull length), seen from the berth cards in the same flow. Its probe reproduces D03's outcome: a 9.6 m hull length is accepted on B14 for a boat 10.4 m overall.

assertions.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
